Method of Attack: .NET deserialization vulnerability in Ad Hoc Transfer Module enabling unauthenticated remote command execution via HTTP requests
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2023-40044 .NET deserialization vulnerability in WS_FTP Server Ad Hoc Transfer Module
HTTP requests to execute commands remotely
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code released by Assetnote
Ransom letter demanding $500 ransom payable by October 15, Moscow Standard Time
Internet-exposed WS_FTP servers listed on Shodan (~2,000 devices)
